# Brie Events

Lang: en-ZA

> Brie Events is a Somerset West local business marketed as Brie Cakes. Polite Ndoro makes custom birthday cakes, celebration cakes, cupcakes, bento cakes, wedding and event cakes, and selected party treats for customers in the Helderberg, Stellenbosch, and Cape Town.

Brie Cakes is the customer-facing cake brand of Brie Events. The website focuses on cakes. "Brie Events Cakes and More" is an alternate form of the same business name.

Canonical: https://brieevents.co.za/

## Services

- [Custom cakes in Somerset West](https://brieevents.co.za/#cakes): Birthday, celebration, wedding, and event cakes made to order
- [Birthday cakes in Somerset West](https://brieevents.co.za/birthday-cakes-somerset-west): Ordering guidance for custom birthday cakes
- [Kids themed cakes](https://brieevents.co.za/kids-themed-cakes-somerset-west): Guidance for themed children's cake briefs
- [Cake prices](https://brieevents.co.za/cake-prices-somerset-west): Current starting-price guide and quote factors
- [Delivery and collection](https://brieevents.co.za/cake-delivery-collection-helderberg): Handover, transport, and storage guidance
- [Bento cakes and cupcakes](https://brieevents.co.za/bento-cakes-cupcakes-somerset-west): Small-format celebration options

## What We Do Not Do

- Brie Events does not publish a fixed price for every custom design; Polite confirms each quote from the final brief.
- The business does not guarantee an allergen-free product unless Polite confirms the request in writing.
- Delivery is not automatic for every order or area; customers must confirm availability before payment.
- Inspiration photos guide the brief and do not guarantee an exact copy of another baker's work.

- Primary service area: Somerset West and the Helderberg
- Additional areas by arrangement: Strand, Gordon's Bay, Lwandle, Sir Lowry's Pass, Heldervue, Stellenbosch, and Cape Town
